newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has constituted a 54-member committee to formulate a fresh national education policy.
The High Court on Monday ordered stay of the government order relieving two senior officials of the Securities and Exchange Commission, the stock market watchdog.
The government has taken steps to legalise the Bangladeshi workers living in Malaysia illegally, Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad told the parliament on Monday.
The Joint River Commission (JRC) will soon take up the matter of augmentation of water flow at the Farakka barrage point as per the agreement between Bangladesh and India.
The India-Bangladesh treaty on sharing of the Ganges water was placed in the parliament on Monday.
The body of a Bangladeshi farmer, shot dead by Indian border security forces on Friday, could not be recovered till Monday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina urged Chinese entrepreneurs to invest in a massive way in Bangladesh.
A Pakistani diplomat in Dhaka criticised the proposed sub-regional grouping in South Asia, saying the bloc would "undermine the spirit of SAARC".
